+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["dev", "eval-fair"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("configured_limit", [2, 8])
+def test_native_rpc_honors_the_stricter_step_limit(
+    monkeypatch, agent_module, make_agent, mode, configured_limit
+):
+    limit = min(configured_limit, 5)
+    calls = []
+    native = SimpleNamespace(
+        take_action_cnt=[limit - 1], step_lim=5, is_success=lambda env_idx: False
+    )
+
+    def apply(action, action_type, *, eval_fair):
+        calls.append(action)
+        native.take_action_cnt[0] += 1
+
+    agent = make_agent(
+        native,
+        meta={"mode": mode, "max_episode_steps": configured_limit},
+        slot=SimpleNamespace(env=native, apply_action=apply),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(agent_module, "_obs_dict", lambda *args: {"state": {}})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        agent_module, "_reward_details", lambda *args: {"reward": 0, "step_limit": 5}
+    )
+    _, _, _, info = agent.step_native({})
+    assert info["status"]["step_limit"] == limit
+    assert agent.get_status()["step_limit"] == limit
+    assert agent.get_reward_details()["step_limit"] == limit
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="budget"):
+        agent.step_native({})
+    assert calls == [{}]
+    assert native.take_action_cnt == [limit]
+    assert native.step_lim == 5

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("command", "measured", "label", "target"),
+    [(1.0, 0.65, "close_commanded", 0.0), (-1.0, 0.9, "open_commanded", 1.0)],
+)
+def test_gripper_reports_command_separately_from_feedback(
+    command, measured, label, target
+):
+    state = {
+        "left_ee_joint_state": [1.0],
+        "right_ee_joint_state": [0.3],
+    }
+    calls = []
+
+    def step(action):
+        calls.append(action)
+        return (
+            {"state": {"left_ee_joint_state": [measured]}},
+            0,
+            False,
+            {"status": {"step": 1, "step_limit": 10}},
+        )
+
+    primitives = SimpleNamespace(
+        env=SimpleNamespace(get_obs=lambda: {"state": state}, step=step)
+    )
+    result = tools.set_gripper(primitives, None, "left", command).data
+    assert result["gripper"] == label
+    assert result["target_opening"] == target
+    assert result["measured_opening"] == measured
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    assert calls[0]["left_ee_joint_state"] == [target]
+    assert calls[0]["right_ee_joint_state"] == [0.3]
+
+
+def test_gripper_does_not_invent_missing_feedback():
+    primitives = SimpleNamespace(
+        env=SimpleNamespace(
+            get_obs=lambda: {"state": {}},
+            step=lambda action: (
+                {},
+                0,
+                False,
+                {"status": {"step": 1, "step_limit": 10}},
+            ),
+        )
+    )
+    result = tools.set_gripper(primitives, None, "left", 1.0).data
+    assert result["gripper"] == "close_commanded"
+    assert result["measured_opening"] is None
